_comment: Hashes below are pinned to the current public HEAD of each repo (resolved via `git ls-remote`), so this file is deployable as-is. For byte-exact reproducibility of the shared Comfy box that already renders these workflows, replace this with a ComfyUI-Manager 'Save Snapshot' export from that instance (Manager menu -> Save Snapshot). See README.md. This shared snapshot targets the image-correction machine (Qwen GGUF + SDXL FaceID); the two Wan video machines can use the leaner snapshot.video.json (they use only core nodes).
_notes: ControlNetLoader / ControlNetApplyAdvanced / ImageScaleToTotalPixels / ImageToMask / SetLatentNoiseMask / KSampler(Advanced) / VAEEncode / VAEDecode / CheckpointLoaderSimple / CLIPTextEncode / UNETLoader / CLIPLoader / VAELoader / LoadImage / SaveImage are core ComfyUI nodes — no extra repo needed, just a comfyui core hash recent enough to have them.

TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus / ModelSamplingAuraFlow / CFGNorm (Qwen-Image support) and Wan22ImageToVideoLatent / Wan22FunControlToVideo / ModelSamplingSD3 (Wan 2.1/2.2 support) are also core, not custom nodes — the pinned 'comfyui' hash above is current public HEAD, which postdates their introduction.

LoadVideo / SaveVideo / CreateVideo / GetVideoComponents (used in both Wan video workflows) are also core built-in nodes (docs.comfy.org/built-in-nodes/SaveVideo) as of mid/late-2025 ComfyUI releases — not the older ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite custom node pack.
